supporting.title: A glass of water when you wake up

days.title: Take a {minutes}-minute walk in daylight
days.reason: Light and movement can help you feel more awake.

days.title: Drink a glass of water and stretch gently for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Water and a gentle stretch can wake your body up.

days.title: Wind down for {minutes} minutes so you sleep a little earlier
days.reason: Good sleep is one of the best sources of energy.

days.title: Take a {minutes}-minute walk after lunch
days.reason: A walk after a meal can help with the afternoon dip.

days.title: Step outside for {minutes} minutes of fresh air
days.reason: Fresh air can help you feel refreshed.

days.title: Eat a balanced breakfast and take {minutes} minutes to enjoy it
days.reason: A good breakfast can help you feel steady in the morning.

days.title: Take a {minutes}-minute walk and notice your energy after
days.reason: Noticing what gives you energy helps you do more of it.
